description: Enhance your home entertainment setup with the PHILIPS SWV5531 HDMI Cable, engineered for exceptional performance and crystal-clear 4K UHD picture quality. Delivering vibrant colors, sharp details, and lifelike visuals, this cable is perfect for streaming, gaming, and high-definition media playback. With dynamic 3D support, the PHILIPS SWV5531 transforms your viewing experience by bringing movies, games, and multimedia content to life with impressive depth and realism. Its built-in Ethernet capability provides reliable internet connectivity between compatible devices, reducing cable clutter and improving convenience. Enjoy an immersive sound experience with advanced 32-channel audio support, ensuring rich, powerful, and high-quality sound output. With ultra-fast data transfer speeds of up to 18 Gbps, this HDMI cable guarantees smooth, lag-free transmission of audio and video content. Designed for durability and consistent performance, the PHILIPS SWV5531 HDMI Cable is an ideal choice for TVs, gaming consoles, projectors, Blu-ray players, and more—delivering premium connectivity for your digital lifestyle.
